business: May11Leven Labs, a small design and technology studio (brand identity, websites, apps, 3D, automation, AI agents, content) that markets itself on Instagram and LinkedIn
by_segment: Owner or GM of a 12-30 room boutique hotel or lodge
Marketing or revenue lead at a small hotel group
why_not: Booking.com is where my guests already find me and trust the payment. A pretty site and an app for a 12-room place sounds nice, but my guests don't download apps, and I'm not paying $800 to fight Booking.com when my template site already works.

It is a pretty concept for a guesthouse I have never seen, with no booking numbers behind it. Every agency that has pitched our group has promised more direct bookings and I have never seen the figures.

I already pay for a booking engine and a channel manager, and they take bookings and send confirmations. I don't see what a guest app and a WhatsApp bot add that I can't do myself on my phone at midnight.

I already pay SiteMinder for the booking engine and channel manager, so a studio selling me a booking page and a WhatsApp bot sounds like a second system I would have to run. The 15-25% Booking.com cut is my real pain, but nothing here shows me how it saves money on my own bookings.

The look is lovely and I do follow design hotels, but this reads as a studio selling a whole system before I know what it costs. 'Brand identity from $800' is only the start, and a guest app plus a WhatsApp assistant sounds like more money and more work for me to run every week.
flip: Proof from a guesthouse like mine, in Lamu or Diani, that direct bookings went up by enough to cover the fee and the cost of the site, shown to me in numbers.
Proof, in numbers from a property like mine, that direct bookings rise enough to cover the full cost, with the setup done by someone who stays on to fix it.
A clear answer that it connects to my existing channel manager, plus a real guesthouse of my size showing its share of direct bookings went up with the same setup.
A clear before and after on a hotel like mine, with real direct booking numbers and the cost of the deposit and WhatsApp setup written down.
A named hotel of similar size showing its direct booking share before and after, with the figures checked by someone I know.
A month of real case numbers from a lodge like mine showing direct bookings rising without a drop in Booking.com visibility, with the setup run for me by the studio.
A free trial month where a few of my own Booking.com guests book the direct page and the boat transfer and deposit work with M-Pesa, with no fee until the guests arrive.
A real lodge like mine showing direct bookings went up while its Booking.com visibility stayed the same, with the numbers to prove it.
Two or three named guesthouses they have actually worked with, with booking figures I can phone and check, showing commission and no-show numbers before and after.
A clear, all-in price for my size of property, plus a worked example from a guesthouse like mine showing the direct bookings it actually brought in.
